The first time I ever heard about Sheinside was when a beauty/fashion guru blogger from my country posted a Sheinside haul with a bunch of stuff she bought there. There were plenty of pics with her wearing the clothes and links to specific pieces she was showing on the website. I  could tell right away that these clothes indeed looked just as good on her as they did on the website's promo pictures which is a fabulous sign of quality. That really impressed me, cause I had a bad experience with a popular online clothes store (that shall remain unnamed) when I made an order and the dress I received looked NOTHING and I repeat nothing like the pictures. But anyway, her review was so stellar and excited that I decided to make a purchase myself. I like fashion that's a bit edgy and funky and the Sheinside website had loads of selection so I was able to find a bunch of stuff that I really really liked. I really liked the website outlay as it was intuitive and easy to follow. The order process was so easy as well. Buuuut... Since I had the previous bad experience with the shall-remain-unnamed site, I went to check the reviews for the store first, and trustpilot was one of the first ones I checked. And let me tell you, it got me a bit worried. There were several bad reviews and unhappy customers, people complaining that it took forever or that they did not get their stuff at all or that the stuff was not as good as expected. So, for my first purchase I just bought a single (very sweet btw) shirt, to make sure everything goes well. I certainly didn't want to spend a lot of money and end up pissed and disappointed - again. And let me tell you, I have no idea what these people are talking about! My experience was brill! My package got to me rally really fast and was wrapped up nicely. The clothes were as good as the pictures were, really nice fabrics. I have since made several more purchases and never had a single problem. That's why I decided to make this review so that people can make a more informed decision. One word of caution though. Please be careful when choosing sizes and go by the measurements. When in doubt, go a size larger. And have fun! I love love love this store, and I'm so glad I made a leap of faith and gave it a go.

I thought it had become available and clicked the 'down' buttom.  Next thing I knew, I had a flash message, 'your order has been placed' this was in excess of £100 which I don't have. I immediately prepared my message to Wish according to their instructions.  I have since been told I am unable to cancel the order (for any reason) and I can returnt he items except for postage costs.  I cannot speak with Wish (can't afford the call to the USA) so I am stuck.  I DID NOT authorise any payment separately other than inadvertently press one button. I had my reservations about buying from here as I read a LOT of terrible reviews saying how the products were terrible quality, the shipping caused loads of trouble and how the whole site is a scam. Well from my personal experience this is completely untrue. I bought a white cotton summer dress and a PU leather bag which are amazing quality. I didn't read the description of the dress in depth enough so it was a welcome surprise to find that the dress was even lined. It was a one size dress which made me nervous, but as the back was elasticated it fit absolutely perfectly. It's amazingly well made, wonderful quality and looks lovely on. I am more than happy with the dress and the bag is also amazing, well stitched and sturdy. Another thing I was nervous about was the shopping as some reviews said it took up to a month to reach them, but as it comes from china, I expected this and was happy to wait this long, however I recieved it within a week which I was not expecting. Payment went through smoothly (via PayPal) and I had no problems with that. The order tracking kept me updated every time the package made any sort of movement so I knew where it was at all times. The bargain prices on this website are literally that, a bargain, I managed to get these amazing quality clothes for only £22, and being a student I like to get my clothes as cheap as possible. Overall I would absolutely recommend this website to everyone and I think it's amazing. I'd just recommend checking the sizing of the clothes as it's coming from china, so the sizes are slightly smaller (I'm normally a small but I fit a medium from this site) but if you read the detailed size guide you will be able to work out what you need. I urge people not to worry about bad reviews, my experience with this website was fantastic and I will absolutely be buying from here again.

Nobody tried to deliver, no note was left anywhere. I am going away and needed these goods for holiday. Customer Service would not cancel the order now and refund money. As previously, they told me to wait for delivery, despite the unreasonable delays, then have me return it and then wait several weeks again for a refund. This company seems to have a policy of standard untruthful responses to customers, and of aiming to retain customers money as long as possible. These are unethical policies and I am now compelled to report them to the appropriate watchdog authorities and You and Yours programme.

Review: I bought a pair of Zign mens boots last year for £120 .I really liked these boots and received many complements about them,and i was also asked by friends where i had purchased them,and i told them that they were from Zalando.To cut a long story short,I have worn these boots between 15-20 times in the time I have had them.Soon after I had worn them a couple of times,I noticed that the front of the left shoe had some damage to it.The midsole appeared to be disintegrating.I thought that I must have tripped or caught my foot on something ,so I ignored it.A couple of months later,I wore the boots again,and this time the heel of the midsole had the same damage to it,which was very strange.I could not have tripped backwards.I tried to prevent any further damage by using superglue to fix the disintegrating sole.A few wears later,the exact same damage to the front and back of the right foot boot appeared.I have a second pair of a different design, of Zign boots bought from Zalando which are perfectly fine.I wear these much more than the defective pair of boots,with no problems at all.I contacted Zalando customer services and explained my problem with the boots.In short,I was told that had I not glued the boots,I MAY have received assistance from Zalando,but as this was not the case ,and I HAD tried to repair the defective boots,Zalando basically said they were not going to do anything about my issue.In short,beware of what you buy from Zalando as you may be throwing away good money.I have dozens of pairs of shoes,and NONE of them have ever had this problem of defective materials/craftmanship before.My review rating is correct apart from the fact they were not rude but they will simply not help with anything regarding my issue.

First of all this is unacceptable, Zalando know I do not have the order so why am I being penalized because their delivery people have mucked up? How is it that they can refund the money immediately when the customer is returning a parcel and have no idea of the condition of the goods, when they will receive it etc  but when the customer has never even laid hands on the order due to the ineptitude of the delivery company they have to wait. Who knows when they will manage to return it. I have requested an immediate refund but so far no success.  I understand that the cause of the problem is the delivery company but Zalando need to get their act together to ensure customers come first.

Review: I ordered about $120 of merchandise after my friend told me about this website. She has ordered from here several times and never had any trouble... I placed my order and received an email right away about it. Then 8 days later I received an email that my order had shipped. Naturally I was upset that it took so long to ship out so I tried to contact them. The chat responses are automated so don't try that, email if you really want answers. I started to look up reviews on the site after all this happened and was so scared I had been ripped off! The clothes eventually came, about 2.5  weeks after I ordered them. Each shirt came wrapped in a resealable thick plastic clothing bag, everything had tags, and nothing smelled bad. Yes they smelled like plastic but most clothes do when they come from online. They even gave me a Christmas present, a free pair of wool shorts. I was really surprised. The quality reflects the price... I mean what do you think you are going to get for such cheap clothes and free shipping?? And no the clothes don't look EXACTLY like the picture... The sizes are Asian, so they run smaller than American sizes. All of the things I ordered were "one size fits all" and only one of the 6 items was way smaller than it looked online. Everything else fits perfectly, I'm 5'6 and 125lbs.  Overall, do not order if you are in a hurry or need for a special occasion. Things may take up to a month to arrive but I will probably order from them again. Oh and I used PayPal to pay cause I was kind of sketched out about it being a foreign site.

you pay for what you get? NOT
Review: It usually is true when people say you get what you paid for but this is often not true IF you're a smart shopper (like me) especially when dealing with China based retailers/suppliers, it goes the same everywhere. First tip, check the reviews before purchasing. Note that there can be many "fake" reviews by people who just wants to collect sheinside points for discounts it is usually very identifiable because no one would only put "excellent!" or "pretty" etc if they're actually really happy about the purchase and decided to even put some effort to leave a review. look out for negative comments and see if it applies to you because may shoppers do not look at the measurements of the clothing (which is also the 2nd tip, ALWAYS CHECK THE MEASUREMENT DETAILS!!!) before buying (you should know your own body's measurement if not just get a measuring tape. it only costs like 1 dollar on ebay). As asian sizes often run small, a US size S body will never fit into an Asian size S clothing. so please check the measurements, i get annoyed when people leave a negative comment for not reading the details and measurements prior to their purchase. What to do if there's no reviews, don't buy it just yet. if you're really into that specific clothing, check around Aliexpress for their reviews because there's many sellers selling the same chinese stuff from the same suppliers. If that still doesnt work, I'd advise you to save your money and just be patient to wait for reviews. Also, people might ask why buy from Sheinside if Aliexpress is almost always cheaper (up to half the price)? I think it really depends on how broke you are at the time and how urgent you need the clothing. Sellers from aliexpress offers cheap prices with the cheapest mode of shipping which can take more than 1 month to arrive at your doorstep, aliexpress does not accept Paypal anymore. Sheinside ships your items with priority parcels (as far as I know, it ships to australia with TOLL which took less than a week every time). I'm not sure about other countries though. I've purchased from Sheinside for the 3rd time now with more than 10 pieces of clothing, only to have one which was sent in the wrong size but got partially refunded. On overall, i'm quite glad i found this website and will be happy to purchase from them again. Wish you all the best on your shopping journey.

My only complaint would be the size guides - considering they're a marketplace that retails A LOT of different brands, rather than having one generalised size guide, they should ensure that each (clothing and footwear) brand that signs up submits their own size guide. That way the sizing information would be more accurate. Other than that, delivery's always by Hermes and whilst I have a really good local Hermes courier, if you do not, this could be a potential issue worth noting. Returns are easy and straightforward, however I've never had to deal with Customer Service so I'm biased. Would be nice if Zalando implemented a points/reward system for those of us who shop on their site regularly. Also, there's only standard delivery option which sucks, because it would be better to offer a Next Day delivery option, however I've never had to pay for delivery on Zalando - it's always free. Overall, I 100% recommend :)
